title: Streaming
description: One JSON op, one event stream and one byte relay.

ops.description: Echo answers the text it was sent.

Count streams n ticks as server-sent events, then [DONE], and reports how
many it sent in the x-sent trailer.

Relay answers the body it was sent, each chunk as it arrives, under the
content type it was sent with.

types.name: Count
types.doc: Count asks for a stream of ticks.

fields.name: n
fields.doc: N is how many ticks to send.

fields.name: every_ms
fields.doc: EveryMs is the pause before each tick, in milliseconds.

types.name: Text
types.doc: Text is a line of text.
